title: The Truth Stays in the Family: Enhancing Contextual Grounding via Inherited Truthful Heads in Model Lineages
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have produced many specialized multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) that share common foundational LLMs, forming distinct model lineages. It remains unclear whether a fundamental behavioral link exists between the foundational LLMs and downstream variants. We investigate this question by quantifying head-level context-truthfulness scores. Across diverse LLM and MLLM lineages, including Vicuna-, Qwen2.5-, LLaMA2-, and Mistral-based models, we find that Truth Scores are strongly preserved within model families, even after instruction tuning or multimodal adaptation. We further show that this inheritance is consistent with attention-head weight preservation, and that context-truthful heads attend to query-relevant evidence. Building on this finding, we propose TruthProbe, a soft-gating strategy that amplifies context-truthful heads while preserving other head contributions. TruthProbe improves contextual truthfulness on HaluEval and reduces multimodal hallucination on POPE and CHAIR, with base-LLM Truth Scores transferring effectively to their fine-tuned LLM and MLLM descendants. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/TruthProbe.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2606.15821v2 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 available（https://github.com/miso-choi/TruthProbe）。
analysis.ideaZh: ICML 2026 的 TruthProbe 用 linear probes 给 attention heads 计算 context-truthfulness score，发现这些 heads 在 base LLM、instruction-tuned LLM 与 MLLM descendants 内高度继承；推理时 soft-gate 放大这些 heads，即可改善 HaluEval、POPE 和 CHAIR。亮点是用 base-LLM scores 干预整个 model lineage，但 probe correlation 不等于稳定因果机制，且部署需要访问内部 heads。
methodFlow: 在真假上下文数据上逐 attention head 做 linear probing
生成并跨 lineage 比较 Truth Scores
检验高分 heads 的权重与 query-evidence attention
推理时 soft-gate 放大 truthful heads
在 LLM/MLLM hallucination benchmarks 评估
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接关联 MLLM hallucination、mechanistic interpretability 与 training-free grounding intervention。
analysis.evidenceZh: Truth Scores 通过 head-level linear probes 计算，并在同一 model family 内高度相关。（Sec. 3 and Fig. 2, p. 5）；作者报告 base-LLM Truth Scores 可直接用于 descendant MLLMs，在 POPE 上取得与 MLLM-derived scores 相近增益。（Table 2, p. 6）；作者报告 TruthProbe 在 CHAIR object hallucination 与 HaluEval contextual truthfulness 上也改善。（Tables 1 and 3, pp. 6-7）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：方法需要访问模型内部 attention heads，不适用于闭源 API。；审阅风险：linear probe 可分性与 head importance 存在经典相关—因果鸿沟。；审阅风险：soft amplification 可能在分布外问题上损害其他任务或校准。
analysis.motivationZh: 作者在 Vicuna/Qwen2.5 等家族中用真假上下文数据做 5-fold linear probing，比较 lineage 内 head score 与权重保持；TruthProbe 对高分 heads 进行可调 soft amplification，并测试 base-derived 与 MLLM-derived scores。
analysis.methodZh: 作者在 Vicuna/Qwen2.5 等家族中用真假上下文数据做 5-fold linear probing，比较 lineage 内 head score 与权重保持；TruthProbe 对高分 heads 进行可调 soft amplification，并测试 base-derived 与 MLLM-derived scores。 把 contextual truthfulness 视为模型家族可继承的 head-level trait，并允许用 base LLM probe 直接干预 MLLM descendant，是比逐模型重训更系统的视角。
analysis.experimentsZh: 在 Vicuna/Qwen/LLaMA/Mistral 家族及 LLaVA/Qwen-VL descendants 上用 HaluEval、RLHF-V probing data，评估 correlation、weight preservation、POPE、CHAIR 与 HaluEval。 作者报告：作者报告 base-derived TruthProbe 在 POPE 上与直接从 MLLM 计算的 Truth Scores 获得可比增益。（Table 2, p. 6） Baseline boundary：覆盖多个 lineage、LLM 与 MLLM benchmarks；架构差异大或经过强 post-training 的跨 family transfer 尚未证明。 Ablation boundary：比较 base/descendant scores、不同 λ、随机 heads 与 attention behavior；仍需 head ablation/causal mediation 和长文本稳健性。
analysis.insightZh: 把 contextual truthfulness 视为模型家族可继承的 head-level trait，并允许用 base LLM probe 直接干预 MLLM descendant，是比逐模型重训更系统的视角。 跨 lineage 设计和多 benchmark 证据较强，值得精读；不能把 probe correlation 夸成已证实的单一真值电路。
